# Kafka send that is not awaited and ignores errors

> `recordClick` sends a `link.clicked` event to Kafka without waiting for it and ignores any failure, so the redirect never waits on Kafka.

_Part of [Recording a click without slowing the redirect](fire-and-forget-click-recording.md)_

A short link redirect has to be fast. Counting the click is nice to have, but it must not slow the user down. So `recordClick` in [`ShareLinkService`](link-click-analytics.md) is a plain function that returns nothing, not a promise. When it runs, it builds a `link.clicked` event (see [Click event built inside recordClick](link-clicked-event.md)) and hands it to the Kafka producer. It starts the send with `void` and adds a `.catch` that does nothing (see Kafka send that is not awaited and ignores errors). The redirect carries on at once and never learns if Kafka was slow or down. The event goes out with the link code as the message key. The controller decides whether to call it at all: if the edge already counted the click, it skips `recordClick` so nothing is counted twice (see [Skip when the edge already counted the click](edge-already-recorded-check.md)). Later, [Link click attribution and stats](link-click-analytics.md) picks the event up and stores it.

**Look at:** [`recordClick` in share-link.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/share-link.service.ts#L107)

## Pieces

- Kafka send that is not awaited and ignores errors: The producer `send` is started with `void` and a `.catch(() => undefined)`, so the caller never waits and never sees a failure.
- [Click event built inside recordClick](link-clicked-event.md): Each click gets a new time-ordered [`uuidv7`](../../../../packages/backend/scripts/load-tests/lib/utils.js#L14) click id, the current time, country and referer (cut to 300 characters), and a flag for whether the edge sent it.
- [Skip when the edge already counted the click](edge-already-recorded-check.md): The controller only calls `recordClick` when the edge has not already recorded the click.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| queue | `links.events (topic from ``LinkClicked.topic``)` | `recordClick` sends the `link.clicked` event here, keyed by the link code. |
| event | `link.clicked` | Versioned event with click id, code, time, country, referer and via-edge flag. |

## Watch out

- Failures are silently dropped: if Kafka is down, the click is simply lost, with no log and no retry.
- Because the function returns `void`, callers cannot await it or check whether it worked.
- The `.catch` only covers the send; building the event inside `recordClick` still runs before it and could throw.
- The referer is cut to 300 characters before sending.
